item.description: LOWELL — The holiday season may be over, but the giving spirit of Greater Lowell shines on as the elves at The Sun Santa Fund continue to tally up all of the community’s generous donations to this season’s campaign.

item.title: The Five Minute Read
item.description: The Five Minute Read highlights things to do, places to go and people to know in the Greater Lowell area. Have news to share? Send it to news@lowellsun.com. Submissions must be received at least one week in advance to be considered for publication.

item.title: Howard wins state Senate primary race over Elliott in unofficial results
item.description: LOWELL — State Rep. Vanna Howard has won the Democratic Primary state Senate election over state Rep. Rodney Elliott, 3,326-2,369, on Tuesday in the 1st Middlesex District.

item.title: Cooper Flagg scores 36 points, but Celtics top Mavericks
item.description: DALLAS (AP) — Jaylen Brown had 33 points and 11 rebounds, and the Boston Celtics beat Dallas 110-100 on Tuesday night, overcoming another stellar showing from Cooper Flagg and handing the Mavericks their season-worst fifth consecutive loss. item.title: Editorial: Open Meeting Law mandates still elude some public officials
item.description: For some reason, the state’s Open Meeting Law may qualify as the least understood among the state’s statutes, even for the elected municipal and other local boards bound by its language. Designed to ensure government transparency and accountability, the law requires that most meetings of public bodies be conducted openly, so that residents may have access to deliberations.
